title: Assign STEP models to footprints by name match
summary: Opens PCB libraries from code, replaces each footprint's 3D bodies with a body loaded from a STEP file whose name matches the footprint, places it at the reference point, and saves and closes the libraries.
phrasings: batch assign 3D models to footprints from a folder
match step files to footprint names
replace component bodies in a PcbLib and save it
open a PCB library from code and save it

commands.name: AssignStepModels
commands.description: Assign STEP models to PcbLib footprints by name prefix
commands.params: Libs=<.PcbLib>[;<.PcbLib>...] (required)|StepFolder=<folder with .step/.stp files> (required)|RotX=0|RotY=0|RotZ=0 (degrees)|Z=0 (mil)|Subfolders (flag: search subfolders)|KeepExisting (flag: keep the existing 3D bodies)

commands.name: ListBodies
commands.description: List the 3D bodies of each footprint of a PcbLib (read-back)
